zones.title: Zones
zones.hint: Set the stage you have reached in each zone. Stage progress resets every Monday.

justus.title: {expert} {skill} level
justus.none: No level set, so no bonus is added.
justus.help: Adds Glowstone to your weekly Labyrinth payout. Read only here, the level is set on the Experts page.

milestones.title: Labyrinth Core rewards
milestones.hint: You have {cores} Cores. Each first clear of a stage gives 1 Core.

rules.title: How Glowstone is counted
rules.body: Each zone pays Glowstone once a week, on the first day it opens. Every cleared stage in the zone gives {perStage} Glowstone. The Justus bonus is a percent of the weekly total, rounded down. The game's own rounding is not confirmed, so the total can differ by a few Glowstone.

formations.title: Labyrinth formations
formations.description: Choose the heroes and the troop split you use in each zone.
formations.heroesHint: Pick one hero of each class for each formation. A hero can be in only one formation of this zone. A troop split totals 100%, or leave all three at 0 to skip it.
formations.troopsHint: Heroes are blocked in this zone. Set the troop split. It totals 100%, or leave all three at 0 to skip it.

toast.title: Formations saved
toast.message: Your Labyrinth formations are up to date.
